label: Wave 2 — New platform knowledge

orderingRule.description: Deterministic review order without confidence or priority scoring

decisionSemantics.accepted: Legitimate manufacturer/platform-specific knowledge worth retaining as implementation knowledge. Does not change frozen canonical ontology and is not canonical promotion.
decisionSemantics.rejected: Not valid platform knowledge, extraction noise, wrong classification, or unsupported by source context.
decisionSemantics.deferred: Ambiguous, insufficient evidence, architecture conflict, or appears to require a new canonical functional abstraction — defer for architecture review.

governanceNote: Human question: is this useful implementation knowledge without expanding universal ontology? Accept ≠ promotion. Suspected new canonical node → defer.

knownCorpusPatterns.reviewNote: Patterns inform judgment only — no blanket auto-reject; use candidate provenance and context.
